column1: # Prebuilt chat rust binaries shipped with the chat skill: the server, the
# CLI client, the MCP adapter that carries the same client as a library, and the
# spool watcher an agent arms as a Claude Code Monitor to be woken when its chat
# interrupts go unread. integration.tsv decides which front end an install receives.
# Built by the release/CI (cargo build --release --workspace); never committed.
